state: built (south and north fronts and prow measured; east end inferred)

destination.name: Hotel Jakarta
destination.note: No installed model, native-kit POI or poi-work-queue task covered this pand (checked by name and landmarkId); no OSM or backlog destination exists, so a model-local landmarkId is used (as for Woongebouw Wladiwostok). BAG pand 2018, status in gebruik; verblijfsobject Javakade 766 (nummeraanduiding 0363200012107293) lies inside it.

facts: Designed by SeARCH for WestCord Hotels on the west tip of Java-eiland; first pile April 2016, opened summer 2018.

Eight storeys above ground with a skybar on top and a car park below; concrete basement, concrete columns and walls on the ground floor and first floor, timber structure above; rooms prefabricated off site; 16,500 m2, energy neutral.
V-shaped volume with tapering north and south fronts; the glazed point holds a partly public subtropical garden made with the Hortus Botanicus.
A perforated aluminium panel on the east side shows the silhouette of a VOC ship (photographed ghosted on the copper panel wall beside the north entrance).
Public prize at the Amsterdam Architecture Prize 2019.

measuredBy.3dbag: NL.IMBAG.Pand.0363100012247056 LoD2.2: ground 1.3 m NAP, roof about 32 m above ground over the west part (west of x = 27 on the north line, x = 21.5 on the south line) and 20 m over the east block, roofMax 33.6 m NAP. The BAG ring also covers open garden: a ray probe finds no shell wall on its north and west edges, so the north front is the sawtooth wall line 19 m inside the ring.
measuredBy.panoramas: municipal panoramas of 2024-10-23 and 2025-06-16 for the south front, north front with the rotating-door drum, copper panel wall and glazed prow; capture points were mapped into native metres to place the door (about x = 31 on the north line) and the lettering.
measuredBy.storeys: two glazed storeys (7.4 m) on the IJ side, 5.6 m glass ground floor under a copper spandrel on the north front, then 4 storeys of loggias in the 20 m block and 8 in the 32 m part on a 3.05 m pitch.

limitations: The east facade (about 31 m, facing the Verbindingsdam) has no photograph (no panorama is taken east of x = 40), so it is inferred from the south front.
The facade photographs in Commons suggest a very slight arc in the south front; BAG and 3DBAG give a straight chord, so the model is straight.
Corten planters and umbrellas of the quay terrace are street furniture and are not modelled.
